Results.ReviewText:
New grill and multiple issues, including with Lowe's. We finally got this new grill, our replacement after six years, and Lowe's cancelled delivery three times. The manager at the local Lowe's expedited a delivery and the grill arrived with 17 points of damage, which I documented with photos with my complaint. 
After getting the photos, the manager called me and said this kind of damage 
was typical" with Weber grills they dellvered. I told him that was unacceptable and I demanded a followup from Lowe's. Finally a different manager called and scheduled delivery of a new grill he handpicked before assembly. We had a Saturday morning delivery planned and the Lowe's delivery driver refused to deliver the grill. I got this information because I wanted an update on delivery. The manager did call back and he sent two of employees in a personal pickup to deliver the grill and pick up the damaged one. The replacement grill did arrive without noticeable damage.

I called the manager to thank him and he said finding a grill from Weber without damage, sometimes extensive, is difficult. In fact, he told me Lowe's had delivered a Weber grill and the entire top was "caved in" and Lowe's was trying "to make it right with the customer." If this is the kind of "quality control" that Weber has, your company has major problems.

When I attached the propane tank there was obvious leak at the pressure fitting, so I called Weber, explained the issue, and did receive a new hose and pressure fitting assembly. So far so good.
Results.Title: Quality control?

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback, we appreciate having your valued business! We are sorry to hear you are not pleased with the performance of your new Spirit grill, but we are here to help!

Your grill should be able to reach the same high temperature we expect from all of our grills, at least 450 F. If your grill is not getting that hot, we would suggest double-checking your current gas pressure.  The gas pressure provided to the grill is of the utmost importance, it affects the performance of the burner tubes. 

Here is a link we would like to provide for review:
https://consumer-care.weber.com/hc/en-us/articles/4977860598036-How-hot-should-my-gas-grill-get-

We would like to hear more about this experience. Please lookout for an email from our Support team.

If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.
